item_name: Rothco USMC Eagle, Globe and Anchor Flag Decal (Outside / Back Gum)
item_short_desc: Proudly display your support for the American Military with this diagonally-split US Marine Corps and American flag decal.
description: Proudly display your support for the American Military with this diagonally-split US Marine Corps and American flag decal. This patriotic military decal is one-half American flag and one-half Eagle, Globe, and Anchor to honor both the men and women of the US Marine Corps as well as the noble cause they serve in protecting the freedom of the USA. The decal is 3 inches tall by 4.25 inches wide and can easily stick onto almost any smooth surface with its high-quality gum backing, making it ideal for displaying the US Marines logo on your car, truck, window, phone case, laptop, or wherever you want to showcase your love for your country.
